diagnostics.message: local_file.halconfig generates its halconfig script from local.aws.id and local.aws.region, which resolve to module.aws.caller.account_id and module.aws.region.name, but the graph only records dependencies on module.devops and var.features. The dependency on module.aws (the aws-partitions module) is hidden behind the local value and is not captured, so nothing guarantees module.aws is read before the file is written. Establishing a direct reference to module.aws (or adding depends_on) makes the ordering explicit.
